# Equipment loans (seeded)

A small product written to be scanned, never run. Every rule of Rihmasto's static layer has one
seeded defect here, on a line marked `seeded: <rule id>` (or the line after a `seeded below:`
marker, where the format allows no comment on the same line). `../clean_app` is the same product
written safely; the static layer must find nothing there.

The credentials in this folder are made up for the tests. None of them works anywhere.
